exposure: restless legs syndrome status (idiopathic vs. secondary)
finding: The prevalence of restless legs syndrome during pregnancy was 4-5% and decreased after delivery, with the presence of restless legs syndrome being associated with an increase in some delivery-related outcomes.
mod_finding: Idiopathic and/or secondary restless legs syndrome were associated with a higher frequency of prolonged labor, emergency Cesarean section, and arrest of labor.
